 BTS the City Arirang experience is taking over Singapore this December
 By FLOREY D. MIKIL 
 Tuesday, 17 Nov 2026
 | 11:00 AM MYT

 Other than BTS’ four-day concert, fans can also enjoy BTS the City Arirang Singapore throughout December. — Handout 
 Army – the name that fans of K-pop super group BTS go by – can get their tickets to the BTS the City Arirang experience at National Gallery Singapore on Nov 17.
 To be held throughout December, alongside the gallery’s blockbuster exhibition, Pop After Pop: Art Around Us, part of the experience includes Pop After Pop/BTS the City Arirang Art Trail.
 Running from Dec 11-31, the art trail pairs 14 artworks from renowned artists, such as British painter David Hockney and Thai curator Apinan Poshyananda, with songs from BTS’ latest album, Arirang.
 Fans can either do a self-guided tour or join a “specially curated” guided tour, uncovering the stories behind each artwork while listening to the BTS song that accompanies it.
 Sentosa Island will transform into the largest single stop for the BTS fan activation experience. — Pexels 
 From Dec 18-19, BTS the City Arirang Gallery Rave will take place at the Gallery’s Singapore Courtyard. On these two nights, fans can dance away to BTS-inspired remix sets, with immersive lighting and projections adding to the electrifying atmosphere.
 There’s also the BTS Pop-up: Arirang – from Dec 4-31 – which is the flagship pop-up in Singapore that will be held at the Gallery’s Supreme Court Terrace. This will feature official concert merchandise and immersive visual displays.
 That is not all, as fans can also fill up on food and drinks inspired by BTS the City Arirang. These specially curated menus are available at participating dining establishments, such as Bakery Brera, Rempapa and Milli: Sky Dining, Bar & Lounge.
 Fans can complete their Arirang experience by snapping tons of fun photos at the dedicated photo booth and photo spots found throughout the art museum.
 The gallery is just one of the places in Singapore that will be part of the BTS the City Arirang Singapore, which is set to transform the whole city-state into one immersive experience.
 Organised by the Singapore Tourism Board in partnership with Hybe – the South Korean conglomerate that BTS is under – other highlights of the experience include takeovers at Zouk Singapore and Marina Bay landmarks illuminated in Arirang Red lights.
 That is not all – Sentosa Island is set to transform into the largest single stop for the fan activation project.
 From Dec 4-31, several programmes and special features will run across the island, including Arirang Tape Hammock at Sensoryscape; photo points at Central Beach Bazaar, Palawan Green and Palawan Beach; and Arirang themed cable car and Sentosa Express.
 On Dec 12, there is a themed run at Palawan Green. Then from Dec 18-20, there will be a Rave & Drone Party with DJ Raw at Palawan Beach.
 The beach will also feature an approximately 10m-tall Arirang giant inflatable anchoring the beachside activities, which include DJ sets, so fans can have fun from day to night.
 Meanwhile, at Resorts World Sentosa, the activation will run a little longer – from Dec 4 to Jan 3, 2027.
 Throughout this period, fans can enjoy themed fireworks shows at Universal Studios Singapore (USS) on selected nights.
 There is also the BTS The City Arirang Lightscape, a projection mapping that illuminates the Revenge of the Mummy ride with specially curated themed content, which will take place every night from 7.30pm.
 On Dec 21, from 8pm-1am, fans can party the night away at the BTS the City Arirang Night Out at USS. This after-hours celebration includes access to selected rides and will have DJ Jagi spinning hits on the dance floor.
 Tickets to Night Out will include access to the BTS the City Arirang Fan Village, which is taking place at Resorts World Convention Centre from Dec 16-22.
 At the Fan Village, fans can take part in mission-based team challenges. They can also explore the specially curated Play, Taste, and Beauty Zones, where they can snap memories at photo booths, savour food that combines Korean and Singaporean flavours, and personalise their looks with face gems and hair tinsels.
 More information is available at the Sentosa Island website and  Resorts World Sentosa website .
 As first announced two months ago, Singapore is the sole South-East Asian host for the fan activation project. It has previously been held in South Korea’s Seoul and Busan, the United States’ Las Vegas and New York, and in London, England.
 The city-wide fan experience coincides with the K-pop group’s highly anticipated BTS Arirang World Tour in Singapore, to be held Dec 17-22. The group will first perform in Kuala Lumpur on Dec 12 and 13.
